definitions.gloss: jumble; hodgepodge; mishmash; all mixed together
definitions.explanation: A state where different things are mixed together in a disorderly way. Often implies a chaotic or haphazard combination without clear organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{混|ま}ぜこぜだ。
examples.english: The inside of the drawer is all jumbled up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{混|ま}ぜこぜになっている。
examples.english: Japanese and English are all mixed together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{色物|いろもの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白物|しろもの}→白物：30774_shiromono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{混|ま}ぜこぜにして⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧しまった。
examples.english: I washed the laundry with colored and white items all mixed together.

notes:
An informal, colloquial word describing things mixed together in a disorderly way. Derives from ⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧ (to mix).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {混|ま}ぜこぜ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become jumbled/mixed up
- {混|ま}ぜこぜ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mix up, to jumble together
- {混|ま}ぜこぜ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: a jumbled state

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ごちゃ{混|ま}ぜ: jumbled mess (even more colloquial)
- ⟦ごちゃごちゃ→ごちゃごちゃ：09369_gochagocha⟧: messy, cluttered (describes visual disorder)
- ⟦ちゃんぽん→ちゃんぽん：17625_chanpon⟧: mixed up, combined haphazardly (often for mixing drinks or languages)

USAGE:
Describes situations where different categories of things are mixed without order: languages (⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{混|ま}ぜこぜ), laundry items, drawer contents, etc. The nuance is mildly negative — things should ideally be sorted.

REGISTER:
Informal/colloquial. Not used in formal writing.
